{{Quote|She didn't finish her drink. Can I interest you in what's left of a Cassandra Sunrise?|[[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''Cassandra Sunrise''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|intoxicating]] beverage, consisting of several [[Starshine Surprise]]s in the same glass. It was said to be too potent to drink, but would make an excellent sunburn salve for those with extremely thick skin.<ref name="GG9" /> During the [[Galactic War]], the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] codenamed "[[Hunter (Star Cabal)|Hunter]]" attempted to attract the attention of a woman in a bar on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] who was drinking a Cassandra Sunrise. She left, leaving the drink behind.<ref name="TOR" />
